posts.caption: Our brewery rides CONTINUE INTO THE FALL 🍁 Each month we’ll feature a different brewery for our Boston Brewery Meetups, they’ll always be on Tuesday evenings!! This month we’ll be going to Notch Brewing Company in Brighton, at the Speedway @notchbrewing Come hang after work, meet some people, unwind and don’t let daylight savings get the best of ya :)

We’ve gotten the most incredible weather this fall in the Boston area, don’t let this season slip away without getting on a bike and exploring the city with us :) Come on a cafe ride in the Boston area. Beginner-friendly, every single weekend, no bike required just show up. #citybiking #boston #cafebiking #bikeboston

Every weekend! All year long! Supporting our city’s cafes! 🗣️🗣️🗣️ Curious? Check out our links for upcoming ride schedule for easy rides around the city. #citybiking #cafebikers #cafebiking #fika #boston

cargo bikes are taking over the Boston area, they’re a great way to get around with kids, groceries, and furniture. But first, you gotta feel confident enough to ride around on city streets. Come on a cafe ride with us and build that confidence up, and soon enough we’ll get you ready for the cargo bike life 🫡 #citybiking #boston #cafebiking #cargobike

Michette Bakery just opened their second location in Cambridge’s Inman Square, so I took a visit there and I found full bikes racks and families in cargo bikes riding up to the smell of freshly baked bread and pastries. On Nov 7th at 10 AM, we’re hosting our weekly cafe ride ride to @michettebakery. Riders will get a free mini croissant and 10% off their purchase. As always, bluebikes are encouraged and we give a free code for 25$ in credit 💙. #citybiking #cafebiking #cambridge
When you live in a transit and bike obsessed apartment…
Free talk this Wednesday in Somerville!!! Come watch us go on a rant while yall get drunk at @aeronautbrewing #citybiking #boston #cafebiking
If you never gotten the chance to bike across Mass Ave bridge, come with us and we’ll make sure you cross it off your Boston bucket list 🤭 #citybiking #cafebiking #boston
